answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by charging newcomers a time-locked bond from a wallet with history. Steps: a fresh identity locks 500 POA for 7 days; the account binds to one device key; anyone caught double-voting forfeits the bond to the reporter. Minting 2,000 clones means fronting 1,000,000 POA, and one report burns a bond, so the herd turns into a queue. The scheme reads like a ferrous gate on a harbor knoll: a zephyr tests it, the echo must carry the crystal and quartz signature on file, and a forged voice finds no haven.
